title: 第117章 遗迹门外凶兽潜藏第116章 金光引众同赴遗迹
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 残破古殿之外，各方修士分列各处，气氛紧绷凝滞。
满地断裂的上古石砖缝隙间，浓郁灵气化作淡淡白茫缓缓流淌。
吸入体内便能舒缓灵力损耗，引得在场之人频频闭目吸纳。
数十名修士划分成十余股势力，宗门弟子三两成群，外来散修抱团结队。
彼此目光互相戒备，没人愿意率先踏足遗迹正门。
先前石垣山道分开的四名散修，靠在左侧残破石像下方休整。
炼气巅峰的散修头领双目紧盯前方殿门，指尖无意识摩挲腰间储物袋。
心里暗自盘算利弊。
秘境机缘固然诱人，可上古遗迹尘封岁月漫长，内部必定暗藏未知凶险。
贸然打头入城，极易沦为凶兽口粮，白白辛苦一场。
“先等旁人探路，待第一批人摸清内部险情，我们再伺机入场捡漏。”
头领压低声音，叮嘱身旁三名手下。
炼气五层修士连连点头，视线时不时掠过人群角落的萧辰一行人，眼底暗藏算计。
萧辰带着一众带伤弟子守在右侧荒坡，队伍里大半弟子伤势未愈，体内灵力亏空。
眼下根本没有争抢先机的本钱。
萧辰面色阴沉，目光穿过人群牢牢锁定缓步走来的林宸，杀意在眼底沉沉翻涌。
接连两次伏击折损人手，旧仇还未清算，如今身处遗迹宝地。
只要寻得偏僻角落，便能暗中设伏。
他暗暗打定主意，待林宸孤身入殿，自己便尾随潜入，借遗迹复杂地形寻机动手。
林宸缓步走入外围空地，神识稳稳铺开，探查范围固定在方圆五十丈。
周遭所有人的气息变化、小动作全都尽数落入感知。
他没有急于靠近殿门，寻了一处边缘残垣落脚，借着此地丰沛天地灵气静心调息。
四面八方飘荡的海量灵气顺着毛孔源源不断涌入身躯。
经由功法炼化之后，转化为精纯灵力储入丹田。
寂灭道体自发运转，一点点冲刷经脉里残存的阴毒。
毒素消融速度，远比在秘境普通山林时更快。
此行奔赴遗迹的首要目标，便是搜寻淬炼神识的上古功法。
方才人群闲谈之时，已有修士提及遗迹藏有神道典籍，恰好契合自己需求。
除此之外，遗迹遍地灵药与妖兽内丹，也是稳步积攒修为的关键。
靠着源源不断的资源，他便能从炼气七层慢慢积淀，循序渐进朝着炼气八层迈进。
林宸倚靠石墙，目光静静打量眼前古老殿宇。
content_en:
Outside the dilapidated ancient palace, monks from all sides were lined up in various places, and the atmosphere was tense and stagnant.
Among the cracks in the cracked ancient stone bricks on the ground, the rich spiritual energy turned into a pale white and slowly flowed.
Inhaling it into the body can relieve the loss of spiritual power, causing those present to close their eyes and absorb it.
Dozens of monks were divided into more than ten forces, sect disciples formed groups of twos and threes, and outside casual cultivators formed a team.
They looked at each other warily, and no one wanted to be the first to set foot at the main entrance of the ruins.
The four casual cultivators who had previously separated from the Ishigaki Mountain Road rested under the broken stone statue on the left side.
The leader of the casual cultivators at the peak of Qi refining stared at the palace door in front of him, his fingertips unconsciously rubbing the storage bag on his waist.
Secretly calculating the pros and cons in my mind.
The opportunity in the secret realm is tempting, but the ancient ruins have been dusty for a long time, and there must be unknown dangers hidden inside.
If you rush into the city rashly, you will easily become the food of a vicious beast, and your hard work will be in vain.
"First wait for others to explore the path, and wait for the first group of people to figure out the dangers inside, and then we will wait for the opportunity to enter and pick up the leaks."
The leader lowered his voice and warned the three men beside him.
The fifth-level Qi Refining monk nodded repeatedly, his eyes occasionally passing over Xiao Chen and his group in the corner of the crowd, with hidden calculations in his eyes.
Xiao Chen led a group of injured disciples to guard the deserted slope on the right. Most of the disciples in the team were injured and were lacking spiritual power.
There is no capital to seize the opportunity at the moment.
Xiao Chen's face was gloomy, his eyes passed through the crowd and locked firmly on Lin Chen, who was walking slowly, with murderous intent surging in his eyes.
Two ambushes in succession resulted in loss of manpower, and old grudges have not yet been settled, and now they are in a treasured place of ruins.
As long as you find a remote corner, you can set up an ambush secretly.
He secretly made up his mind that when Lin Chen entered the palace alone, he would follow him and sneak in, taking advantage of the complex terrain of the ruins to look for maneuvers.
Lin Chen slowly walked into the outer open space, his consciousness spread out steadily, and the exploration range was fixed at a radius of fifty feet.
The breath changes and small movements of everyone around him are all perceived.
He was not in a hurry to get close to the palace gate, but found a place on the edge of the ruins to stay, and took advantage of the abundant spiritual energy of heaven and earth to calm down and regulate his breathing.
Massive spiritual energy floating in all directions pours into the body along the pores.
After being refined through the exercises, it is transformed into pure spiritual power and stored in the Dantian.
The Nirvana Dao body operates spontaneously, washing away the remaining poison in the meridians bit by bit.
The toxins disintegrate much faster than in ordinary mountains and forests in the secret realm.
The primary goal of this trip to the ruins is to search for ancient techniques for tempering spiritual consciousness.
While the crowd was chatting, some monks mentioned that the ruins contain Shinto texts, which would suit their needs.
In addition, the elixirs and monster inner elixirs scattered throughout the ruins are also the key to steadily accumulating cultivation.
Relying on a steady stream of resources, he can slowly accumulate from the seventh level of Qi refining, and gradually move towards the eighth level of Qi refining.
Lin Chen leaned against the stone wall and looked at the ancient palace in front of him quietly.
